A little note for you

My dearest C2,

Another year around the sun, and I am still the luckiest person to be walking beside you. From the day you walked into my life in red and gold, everything got softer, warmer and so much more fun.

You laugh at my silly jokes, you pose patiently at every lake, temple and museum I drag you to, and you make even a quiet café evening feel like a celebration.

I made this little corner of the internet just to say: you are loved, you are celebrated, and you are my home. May this year give you every smile you give to the rest of us.

Forever yours 💕
